messages.body_plain:
Hi,
I've just upgraded to StatET 3.6. I would like to also install plugin RJ
Servi. However those plugins at:
 http://download.walware.de/rj-2.0
are no more compatible with StatET ("Cannot perform operation. Computing
alternative solutions").

Is the there another update site with newer version of RJ Servi?

Marek Jagielski

messages.subject: Display Format Questions in 3.6
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

  I upgraded to the latest version 3.6 on Windows on Eclipse Neon 4.6.

  I see some nice improvement but I see a couple of apparent glitches:

  (1) IDates no longer format as Dates in the Data Viewer.  They just 
show as Integers.  I have a gazillion objects with IDate columns so this 
is a bit of a setback.  I suppose I  can change my code to store as 
Strings but it is nice having them as IDates for arithmetic etc.

  (2) In the hover over variables in the Editor or the Object Browser, 
the middle mouse button does not scroll down and there is no scroll bar 
either.   This is fairly minor I guess.  It is odd because you can 
scroll both ways hovering over function names to invoke Help.

Thanks so much for the great program!

Don

messages.subject: Re: Display Format Questions in 3.6
messages.body_plain:
Stephen,

  Thanks so much for looking into these!
   Here is an example of the IDate issue:

    x <- data.table(myDate = as.IDate("2017-01-01"))

   When you then view x in the Data Viewer, it now displays as 17167 
whereas in the prior version it displayed as 2017-01-01 . If it is 
displays as an integer, I have no idea what date it is at a glance.

   I have massive stock option data in data.tables with every line 
having multiple IDates for Quote Date, ExpiryDate, Next Trading Day etc. 
among the columns.  I prefer having these as IDates so that I can do 
date arithmetic, although if it is too hard to continue to support  then 
I can change them all to character and convert them to IDates 
temporarily in the code when needed to do date arithmetic.  It would not 
be the end of the world.

  By the way,  I love the new ability to go directly from the hover data 
display to the Data Viewer via clicking on the button in the lower left 
corner of the hover display of a variable.  This is a HUGE effort saver!

  THANKS!

  Don
